media.file: Healthy Red Tomatoes with Water Drops.jpg

sourceEvidence.title: Healthy Red Tomatoes with Water Drops.jpg
sourceEvidence.objectName: Healthy Red Tomatoes with Water Drops
sourceEvidence.description:
Beautiful macro picture of 6 red tomatoes which landed in my tasty salad with other fresh vegetables from the greenhouse garden. This kind of salad is healthy for the long winter as it is for the juicy summer.

This picture was created by my healthy eating friend epSos.de and can be used for free, if you link epSos.de as the original author of the image.

This organic fruits were arranged in a diagonal line on a wooden table of the kitchen.

Those tomatos are ripe and wet, because the water drops are still on this edible food harvest from the green gardening veggies.

Thank you for sharing this picture with your friends !
sourceEvidence.categories: Tomatoes|Taken with Canon PowerShot A650 IS|Flickr images verified by UploadWizard|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation
